positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered an enterprise cloud onboarding portal, automating account requests with Angular, Spring Boot + Java, and DynamoDB for seamless user experience and efficiency.

Achieved scalable and consistent deployment by containerizing frontend and backend applications for Cloud Foundry environments.

Designed and implemented serverless, event-driven workflows to streamline email notifications and automate account request dispositions, ensuring timely and accurate processing.

Optimized build automation for new users by integrating Bazel with Gazelle, resulting in a streamlined setup and improved developer productivity.

Developed and deployed feature-flagged components, enabling dynamic toggling of functionalities without the need for production redeployment, enhancing operational flexibility.

Augmented portal capabilities with a custom installer for automated configuration management using Saltstack, reducing manual intervention and configuration errors.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Empowered Boeing teams to deploy a comprehensive software factory, utilizing Kubernetes to integrate a full suite of end to end software development tools.

Deployed, configured, and maintained the RKE2 Kubernetes platform, leveraging Prometheus and Grafana for robust monitoring and observability.

Developed Helm charts and created hardened containers, addressing and remediating security findings and patches to ensure system integrity.

Authored Terraform modules to automate EKS platform operations, facilitating deployment, upgrades, and minimizing configuration drift in targeted EKS clusters.

Collaborated with Boeing teams to deploy, configure, and maintain a customized development platform, enabling rapid software development without downtime.

Assisted in implementing NIST 800-171 controls, ensuring compliance and enhancing the security posture of the organization.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Integrate, test and deploy Operational flight trainer simulation software

Perform verification and validation of multiple product lines with hardware in the loop

Mock aircraft capabilities by developing reusable libraries that help simulate real world conditions

positions.title: Test Engineer
positions.description:
Develop Qualification, Development and Acceptance Test procedures for Electro mechanical actuators using RTCA DO-160.

Perform Qualification, Safety of Flight (SOF) and Type Inspection Authorization (TIA) testing of electromechanical actuators and systems per DO—160 and MIL STD. (Vibration/Shock, Thermal, EMI Etc.) 

Organize, plan and develop the required documentation packages (including checklists), and support Test Readiness Reviews (TRRs) prior to start of test campaign.

Perform Verification & Validation (V&V) testing. 

Use National Instrument data acquisition systems and LABView to collect and analyze test data.

Use IBM DOORS to perform requirements analysis and perform compliance assessment.

Write compliance and validation documents that justify test specifications.

Use NI MAX & LABView to conduct tests and evaluate test articles.

Investigate, Document and conduct root cause analysis and document FRACAS by collaborating with Design Engineers.

Use PDM software (WindChill/PTC Creo) to pull component drawings and assembly details for use in testing and generating maintenance and performance reports.

Interface with manufacturing, design and assembly teams to streamline testing of production units.

Calibrate, install, repair and maintain test instrumentation.

positions.title: IT Support Technician
positions.description:
Hardware/Software: Basic knowledge of programming languages (C++, Objective C, Visual Basic,). 

Knowledge of communications, networking, and protocols (Transport Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), File Transfer Protocol (FTP), Extensible Mark-up Language (XML), Secure Shell (SSh), Domain Name System (DNS) etc.). 

Knowledge of software development and testing tools (editors, compilers, desktop simulations) capability and usage. 

Basic ability to integrate hardware and software components into a functional system. 

Knowledge of software testing and usability theory and usability practices. Ability to write and execute test scripts and perform usability analyses.  Knowledge of HTML, PHP, CSS and JAVA.

projects.title: Air-Force Research Lab University Nano Satellite Program
projects.description:
•	Performed transient and steady state finite method element analysis to obtain operating temperatures using CATIA, SolidWorks, ANSYS and ESATAN.
•	Created and managed risk criteria and design tradeoffs to mitigate risks
•	Evaluated alternatives to design specifications for controlling the operating temperatures of the components
•	Worked collaboratively with other members in developing system requirements 
•	Attained basic knowledge of design concepts, troubleshooting and debugging techniques.
•	Gained valuable experience deriving system requirements, project management, project and milestone tracking through Microsoft Project and design implementation
•	Analyzed, Created and prepared technical reports regarding engineering and design changes to the thermal system.
